integrity: The Bell-diagonal formula and additivity are credited to prior literature; the claimed contribution is the exact implication for the 2026 preprint's stated post-channel supremum. Numerical values are supplementary to an analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the source's displayed optimization over trace-preserving LOCC-after-channel maps and global relative entropy of entanglement.
A separately constrained distillation optimization that excludes identity by imposing output fidelity, dimension, success, rate, or resource-accounting conditions is not analyzed.
title: The post-channel global relative-entropy optimum is attained by doing nothing
